{{Quote|The whispers of the Imperial Agents became cheers in the arena&hellip; 'Mandalore! Mandalore!' The ancient title of the ultimate warrior king was thrust upon the young gladiator. His infamy grew, and when he called, the Mandalorians rallied to their new master. The new Mandalore secretly served masters of his own, however.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline4" />}}
'''Mandalore the Lesser''' was the title bestowed upon the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper|warrior]] clans during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Before becoming Mandalore, the man was a young member of the then-scattered warrior clans. He lived on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] as one of the many Mandalorian [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]] who participated in arena fights for prestige. Although he was a proficient fighter in his own right, his rise to fame was dramatically accelerated by the intervention of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], an espionage agency of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

[[Imperial Agent|Agents of Imperial Intelligence]] identified the young man as a possible pawn they could use to reunite the Mandalorian clans and direct them into an alliance with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The agents fast-tracked his path to infamy by rigging his gladiatorial matches and spreading the word that he was to become the new warrior-king of his people, Mandalore. He accepted the title and the power it carried, but became subservient to the Empire that built him. As an act of loyalty, the new Mandalore directed his followers to [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. The blockade crippled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against whom the Empire was fighting and placed the Sith as the apparent victors of the Great Galactic War.

Although the blockade on the Hydian Way lasted for a year, it was eventually broken by intrepid [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] led by the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Hylo Visz]]. After the conflict, Mandalore needed to re-energize his people, and so organized the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]&mdash;a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] competition for glory. The Hunt's [[Mandalore the Vindicated|victor]] challenged the Mandalore to a duel and won, killing the warrior-king and claiming the title for himself; becoming Mandalore the Vindicated. It was later revealed to the galaxy that the Mandalore who had risen to fame on Geonosis was nothing more than an Imperial puppet, and history remember him as "the lesser" of the Mandalores.

==Biography==
===Ascension===
{{Quote|The Imperial agents singled out a proud young gladiator to be their pawn. This young gladiator had always fared well in the arena, but with his new Imperial allies, his rise was accelerated to unprecedented levels.|[[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="Timeline4" />}}
[[File:MandalorethePawn.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mandalore meeting with his Imperial puppetmasters]]
During the Great Galactic War, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] tried to recruit the Mandalorians to fight for them. But only a small number of them chose to join. In an attempt to gain all the Mandalorians, [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] decided to find a new Mandalore to reunite the scattered warriors.<ref name="Timeline4" />

The individual who would become this new Mandalore was initially a gladiator fighting in the arenas of Geonosis. Aside from his incredible skills, Imperial Intelligence would sabotage his opponents so he would always win. After rising to prominence there, he took the title of Mandalore<ref name="Timeline4" /> in [[3667 BBY]]<ref name="TECS">"[[Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy]]" indicates that the rise of Mandalore the Lesser takes place 14 years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. As seen in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the Treaty of Coruscant is proposed and ratified in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> and called for the scattered Mandalorians to reunite. The Mandalorians answered, and he promised to lead them to great glory. In reality, the new Mandalore was a Sith puppet.<ref name="Timeline4" />

===Serving the Sith===
{{Quote|Mandalore's call was simple: to confront the galaxy's greatest challenge and fight the legendary Knights of the Jedi Order.|[[Gnost-Dural]]|audio=MandaloresCallWasSimple-Timeline3.flac|<ref name="Timeline3">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians|int=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians}}</ref>}}
[[File:Mandalor_GSW_rally.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Mandalorians reunite under their new Mandalore.]]
The Sith's new alliance with the Mandalore brought the stalemate in the war to a swift end as he led the Mandalorians to [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="Timeline3" />

The blockade rendered the Hydian inaccessible, hindering the Republic war effort and causing a major economic depression in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], fighting on behalf of the Republic, attempted to break the blockade; however, the Mandalorians soundly [[Battle near Devaron|defeated]] them.<ref name="Timeline3" /> Seeing a profit to be made in victory against the Mandalorians, the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Hylo Visz]] later led her fellow smugglers in a [[Battle on the Hydian Way|battle]] against the blockade which resulted in the defeat of the Mandalore's warriors and the opening of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="Timeline2">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref>

===The Great Hunt===
{{Quote|Mandalore was slain recently and his killer, the new Mandalore, has taken his place. Whether or not he's another Imperial puppet remains to be seen but we must watch him closely.|[[Gnost-Dural]]|audio=ColdWarMandalore-Timeline4.flac|<ref name="Timeline4" />}}
Some time after the defeat of the Hydian Way, Mandalore the Lesser attempted to re-energize the Mandalorians and restore his support among them by reviving a several centuries old competition that spanned the galaxy, known as the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]. [[Mandalore the Vindicated|The victor]] of this "new" [[Great Hunt (c. 3660 BBY)|Great Hunt]], however, challenged Mandalore the Lesser to a duel in which he killed Mandalore the Lesser by shooting him to death, and then proclaimed himself the new Mandalore.<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|biographies|mandalore|Mandalore}}</ref><ref name="TOR:TMS">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Galactic History 93: The Mandalorian Schism}}</ref>
